the water-soluble benzyl derivatives BNAG and BNADG are more potent than the methyl derivatives and the O6-benzlguanine for enhancing the cytotoxic effects of cystemustines on chloroethylinitrosourea resistant melanoma cells in vitro and in nude mice bearing M4Beu tumors.
the water-soluble derivatives O6-benzly-N-acetylguanines are more effective than their corresponding O6-methylated derivatives in enhancing the antitumor activity of cystemustines.
the BNAG-cystemustine combination has a greater antitumor efficacy than cystemustin alone.

the water-soluble derivatives O6-benzl-N-acetylguanoine or O6-benyl-N-acetyl-deoxyguanosine are effective in increasing the antitumor action of chloroethynitrosoureas in vitro and in enhancing the antitumor effect of cystemustiune in vivo.
